name: FloatingBar
summary: A small bar that floats over a whole screen at the window's bottom end corner and stays there while the page scrolls: for a few controls that belong to the frame around a screen rather than the screen itself, like a preview's light and dark switch. Not for a screen's own actions (Toolbar), messages (Notifications) or a page's footer.
a11y: A labelled `region` after the screen in the source, so it's reached last with Tab and never covers focus order. It holds ordinary controls with their own names.

props.name: children
props.description: A few compact controls: icon-only segmented controls, small buttons.

props.name: placement
props.description: `window` (default) floats at the window's bottom end corner; `inline` sits in the flow, where it's shown (a library page).
